summary.scope: Targeted release-temporality review of all source units and card fields in targeted-source-review-neurips-2024 and targeted-source-review-neurips-2025 packets. These five checks are not random or full semantic audits. HydraLoRA needs both its future and available source statements preserved. RCG makes no contradictory release claim. OpenMathInstruct-1 keeps its planned release and intended license wording. The MoE paper explicitly keeps code release in the future. Pedestrian privacy has no artifact-release promise in its abstract or invented release claim in the card; it is a temporal-filter false positive. RCG overlaps the pilot and must not be counted as a new fully reviewed record.
summary.limitations: This checks faithful extraction of source release statements only; no live repository availability or reproducibility verification was performed. No cards were edited and no additional model calls were made.
